description: Calculate what a one-time (lumpsum) investment in one Indian mutual fund scheme is worth using actual NAVs: units bought at the NAV on the investment date (or the next NAV date), value at the latest NAV or a chosen end date, absolute gain, absolute return and CAGR. Use for 'if I had invested X on date Y' questions. Ignores stamp duty, exit load and tax; can't project future returns.

end_date.description: Valuation date (optional; defaults to the latest NAV date) in YYYY-MM-DD format

name: calculate_lumpsum_returns
title: Calculate lumpsum returns
